manifest.name: JIANT FM
manifest.author: juanjiant-bit
manifest.description: JIANT's own engines: DRUM-X morphing drum kits, ANIMAL calls, a voice singing words in Spanish, English and Japanese, and bytebeat / floatbeat.

manifest.name: X0X
manifest.author: charlesvestal
manifest.description: X0X's TR-909 and TR-808 drums and its TB-303 bass line, through X0X's own reverb and tape delay.

manifest.name: Melodee
manifest.author: keremimo
manifest.description: Melodee's own engines: a Casio CZ-1 with its 64 factory tones, a Prophet-5 with its 200 factory programs, a C64 SID, and TR-808 circuit and SID drum kits.

manifest.name: OberVave
manifest.author: zvenson
manifest.description: An 8-voice analog-style poly after the classic American polys of 1979-84: two oscillators a voice with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter with a SEM-style morph, its own chorus, ping-pong delay and plate reverb.

manifest.name: Mutable Dreams
manifest.author: Kid Bunka
manifest.description: Mutable Dreams' own voices: Plaits models, Rings' modal resonator, Elements' strike, its own choir, bass, keys and textures, its Biome drum kits, its granular cloud, echo and room.

manifest.name: Frodhes
manifest.author: Leonardo Mirabal
manifest.description: A physically modelled Rhodes (Stage 77, Suitcase, Early Felt, Bell Dyno), vibraphone and marimba, through its own stage-keyboard effects chain.

manifest.name: FiMba-1
manifest.author: jadamsowers
manifest.description: A physically modelled kalimba: modal tines in six materials on a board, box or gourd, with mbira buzzers, wah, grains, tape and a plate reverb.

manifest.name: OPN-1
manifest.author: putchdev
manifest.description: The Mega Drive / Genesis sound chips as OPN-1 plays them: the YM2612's six-voice 4-operator FM and the SN76489 PSG's squares and noise.

manifest.name: Chipbox
manifest.author: Pasquale Barilla
manifest.description: Replicas of the NES (pulse, triangle), Game Boy (pulse, wave) and Master System voices, with their drum kits, envelopes, vibrato, sweep and chord arps.

manifest.name: FOMAJAM
manifest.author: konsumer
manifest.description: FOMAJAM's own modelled drum machines: 808, 909, Simmons SDS-V and CR-78, through its master filter, 11 distortions and reverb.

manifest.name: Tonitor
manifest.author: Nuno Zimas
manifest.description: Tonitor's generative engines for ambient and electroacoustic sound: CALIGULA (a LYRA-8-like organism), ANIMA (a hand-played lo-fi synth), RUSSOLO (noise, logic and bent buffers), BAYAREA (West Coast), HIVE (oscillator swarms) and its FM sound objects.

manifest.name: Bigorna
manifest.author: Nuno Zimas
manifest.description: Bigorna's machines for rhythmic noise, industrial and IDM, after the Digitone II: FM DRUM percussion (kits and pitched), 4-OP FM, WAVY wavetables and the HIVE swarm, through its filters, drive and MANGLE.

manifest.name: GHOULBOX
manifest.author: Jason Persinger
manifest.description: GHOULBOX's dungeon synth: GURDY, a hurdy-gurdy with tunable drones and trompette buzz, its own choirs, organs, lute and harps, crypt pads, FM6 horns and strings, four CC0 recordings and the CRYPT drum kit, with its HALL reverb, tape and medieval tunings.
